test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and %, so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of '::' is the same as that on the right side of '::'? 

# : QLO :: QLO : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : QLO :: QLO : %

Option 1) # = LLP, % = VOY

For # (LLP) to QLO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72ad19ae44a95801edc953fbfd242f5ba6ff3af30d3b713092ce591d6f336d32.png] 

For QLO to % (VOY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52f23d5a2aed20e0ac72bcc0d856163836e5abf8b8e069990187b3875f122301.png] 

Option 2) # = LPU, % = VPY

For # (LPU) to QLO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/351b45bb4dd397ff9d15002d9079909e9780c1184136ff37ce5d1b4c7194cfd2.png] 

For QLO to % (VPY)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd8c6afa01e12ab8a1c2fc2060823d53da11a113fc1a22b631391d70103b697.png] 

Option 3) # = KJJ, % = MYT

For # (KJJ) to QLO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f2d86aa9aacab38673bce6654e4bed88c0af51bd0946c9a71b21da6c2eee66.png] 

For QLO to % (MYT)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653cb5a24ef8d9eb603c2fd7e4239b87eda1d5e9537664888951dc478d1ca111.png] 

**Option 4) # = LGJ, % = VTQ**

**For # (LGJ) to QLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90d2d55b137a50c895d113ed7b98849e3cb1c3e30f726e5de650d745e218954e.png] 

The pattern derived from LGJ to QLO is: (+5, +5, +5).

**For QLO to % (VQT)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5844388d9b10d506a24b2ad04575902468b57603e00250c02ae607e8b5e6fb6a.png] 

The pattern derived from QLO to VTQ is: (+5, +5, +5).

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
